title: Arjun and Bela close their firm
body: Arjun and Bela were partners sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 3:2. Their Balance Sheet on March 31, 2026 showed: Liabilities - Arjun's Capital Rs. 40,000; Bela's Capital Rs. 20,000; Creditors Rs. 30,000; General Reserve Rs. 10,000 (total Rs. 1,00,000). Assets - Bank Rs. 15,000; Debtors Rs. 25,000 less Provision for Doubtful Debts Rs. 1,000 (Rs. 24,000); Stock Rs. 21,000; Machinery Rs. 40,000 (total Rs. 1,00,000). The firm was dissolved on that date. Debtors realised Rs. 23,000. Arjun took over the entire stock at Rs. 18,000. Machinery was sold for Rs. 45,000. Creditors accepted Rs. 29,000 in full settlement. Realisation expenses of Rs. 1,000 were paid by the firm.
